verdict.rationale: Tilled supports merchant applications that can be pre-filled/edited while in 'created' or 'started' status, no-code and API onboarding options, and dashboard progress tracking (API keys, application, first payment) suggesting a staged onboarding flow rather than all-or-nothing. However, there's no explicit documentation of tunable minimum-data-to-start-selling vs. deferred-collection-before-payout, nor explicit 'requirements-due' states tied to payout thresholds. missing for 10: explicit documentation of minimum-fields-to-start-selling vs progressive data collection gated by payout thresholds, named 'requirements due' or similar per-seller status states, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this tunable onboarding flow.
